description: Source code for a Git credential helper that uses libsecret to store and retrieve credentials from the GNOME Keyring, including functions for getting, storing, and erasing credentials, as well as command-line interface handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments and executing credential operations.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential data from stdin into a credential struct.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Outputs credential data to stdout from a credential struct.

methods.name: credential_clear
methods.description: Frees memory allocated within a credential struct.

methods.name: credential_init
methods.description: Initializes a credential struct to default values.
